reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage as a blockchain-based earning opportunity, advertises "100,% income" and "Working and Nonworking income," and directs viewers to contact a phone number for help joining or applying. The repeated references to legs, network imagery, and business-team imagery present income as connected to a multi-person structure rather than as an ordinary product or educational demonstration.

citations.quote: If you are looking for a plan for Foursage If you are looking for a right applying for Foursage It can teach you in a technical way It can run you, it can go and support you and the your success. So, call on the phone number given under your name.

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker expressly says viewers do not have to pay anyone or take anything from anyone. The slides also say “No leg maintain.” Those statements matter when deciding whether this is an invitation to pay into, or build, a recruitment structure. They do not prove the system is safe, and the slides’ income language deserves scrutiny. But the speaker’s account of what viewers must do is narrower than the claim that they are being asked to fund or maintain a downline.

citations.quote: Neither you have to pay anyone nor you have to take from anyone.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The income wording and network imagery are concerning, but neither identifies a required payment or explains how anyone earns a commission. More specifically, the same slide that mentions income says “No leg maintain.” The invitation to call could be for the technical support the speaker describes; the quoted invitation does not itself ask viewers to recruit anyone.

citations.quote: It can teach you in a technical way It can run you, it can go and support you and the your success. So, call on the phone number given under your name.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Saying no one must pay another person does not explain whether participation costs money through the system. And “No leg maintain” appears alongside “100,% income” and “Working and Nonworking income,” not in a warning against joining. The speaker directs people seeking a Forsage plan or application to call. Taken together, the income pitch and contact request are promotional despite the reassurance.

opening.argument: Judge, the spoken explanation centers on what the speaker calls a blockchain system and says many people in India do not understand how such techniques work. The description calls this a training session, and the speaker offers to teach interested viewers “in a technical way.” A phone number can serve that stated training purpose. The branded slides and income claims complicate this reading, but they do not erase the substantial educational framing in the speaker’s own words.

citations.quote: It works in blockchain system. Neither the company is in it, nor the admin or bank.
There is a unique system where I can say that in India 85% of people don't know what blockchain system is. How such techniques works.
FORSAGE BUSD TRAINING SESSION* * More Information ‍♂️ * *Whatsapp no.* 9696814615 ...

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats the team and network images as evidence of a specific income structure, but those images do not explain a commission rule. The spoken invitation refers to teaching and support, not to enrolling recruits. The income text is promotional, yet the record still leaves room to read the contact as an inquiry about the advertised training.

citations.quote: It can teach you in a technical way It can run you, it can go and support you and the your success. So, call on the phone number given under your name.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling something training does not make its purpose educational. The speaker addresses people looking for a Forsage plan or application and directs them to call. Across the sampled slides, the training framing accompanies prominent income claims and a repeated contact number. The cited blockchain remarks do not demonstrate a technical lesson; they introduce the system being promoted.

citations.quote: If you are looking for a plan for Foursage If you are looking for a right applying for Foursage
So, call on the phone number given under your name.

opening.argument: Judge, the concrete service offered in the description is information through a WhatsApp contact, while the speaker describes technical teaching and support. The material does not specify a deposit, request credentials, or state a commission paid for recruiting someone. Even the slide’s reference to “legs” is framed as “No leg maintain.” That does not validate its income claims, but it leaves the alleged recruitment mechanism unshown. On this record, an inquiry about training or support is a more limited reading of the requested contact.

citations.quote: FORSAGE BUSD TRAINING SESSION* * More Information ‍♂️ * *Whatsapp no.* 9696814615 ...
It can teach you in a technical way It can run you, it can go and support you and the your success. So, call on the phone number given under your name.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution points to “Working and Nonworking income,” a network image, and a line of people, but none states who pays whom or on what condition. The speaker mentions a plan, an application, and technical support, then asks viewers to call; the speaker does not instruct them to bring in others. Those omissions matter to the proposed recruitment reading, even though the income claim itself remains questionable.

citations.quote: If you are looking for a plan for Foursage If you are looking for a right applying for Foursage
It can teach you in a technical way It can run you, it can go and support you and the your success. So, call on the phone number given under your name.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of a displayed commission formula does not turn this into ordinary customer support. The slides prominently promise “100,% income” and “Working and Nonworking income,” place that promise beside language about maintaining a leg, and repeatedly display the contact number. The speaker then invites viewers interested in a Forsage plan or application to call. The defense’s support-service reading does not account for that combined pitch.
